req.prompt:
Add a query in a new file src/booking/queries/next_free_slot.rs (register it in src/booking/queries/mod.rs): given a day, a party and a guest, find the earliest free slot (17:00 to 21:30, every half hour) at a table that fits, and hold it for the guest so the next caller is not offered the same one. Work only in those files.

Keep cargo test and cargo clippy (-D warnings) passing. Do not run anything; just edit. No new comments. Reply with one line saying what you changed.

result:
I added `NextFreeSlot` in `src/booking/queries/next_free_slot.rs` and registered it in `queries/mod.rs`. For a day, party and guest, it finds the earliest half-hour slot from 17:00 to 21:30 at the smallest table that fits, saves a booking for the guest to hold it, and returns it (or `None`). I didn't run `cargo test` or `cargo clippy`, so both are unchecked.

It saves a booking to do the holding, so it takes an `IdGenerator` as well as the repository, and it is not read-only like `get_day_schedule`.
